reason: The mechanism holds, but the value is smaller than the finding claims. Checks: exp89t 56669888 was submitted at 09:00:17.723Z, so the 10.75 h admit edge is 19:45:17.7Z; a 19:45:00 stamp gives L_hi 10.745 h. The tools/runtime_ledger.py HEADER regex accepts a '[manual-admit]' suffix. Polls are sorted by timestamp (l.152), and failed_attempts counts only '[empty stdout'/'[ERROR'. lb_poll.py stamps the time before the call, so a manual stamp taken before its call follows the same rule. The poller runs every ~602 s (09:58:37, 10:08:39, 10:18:41), which puts headers at ~19:40:33Z and ~19:50:35Z. The R37-A7(3) 19:47Z poll.log re-read therefore sees only the 19:40:33 header and adds nothing. A completion in (19:40:33, 19:45:17] would code '?' even at 0.960, and only a manual list catches it. The value is overstated about 3-5x. The real window is ~4.7 min (L 10.67-10.75 h), not 10.58-10.75 h. Every CI-family L so far falls between 8.88 and 9.48 h, and none exceeded 9.5 h. P(L in the window) is ~0.2-0.5%, and P(>=0.960 or 0u) is ~0.3 because DIS ~ 0 (probe 52 dd = 0), so the chance this matters is ~0.1-0.15%. When it does matter, the private delta equals the private DIS effect, ~0 +- 0.0003, so private EV is ~0. It is still worth arming: it costs 1 read-only call, changes no files, is logged before the score, follows the manual-A-M1/manual-night precedent, and only stops a correct pre-registered read from being lost to the poller's timing. There is one feasibility trap: the scratchpad timer.sh checks the clock every 30 s and only prints a message, and the session handles it only when free. The finding's plan would often stamp after 19:45:17.7, making the call useless.
fix: Do not arm this with timer.sh or rely on the session. Use one self-contained background bash script, a copy of the night_guards.sh G2 block. (1) Sleep until 19:44:30Z, then sleep 1 s at a time until 19:44:45Z. (2) Exit with no call if the last poll.log header already shows 56669888 COMPLETE/ERROR, or if a poller header is stamped >= 19:44:30Z. (3) Otherwise run TS=$(date -u +%FT%TZ), then 'timeout 60 kaggle competitions submissions -c <comp> -v > _admit_subs.csv', and append '=== $TS [manual-admit]' plus 'head -60' of the CSV to poll.log only if grep '^ref,' matches. Single attempt, no retry, so no failed-attempt +210 s. (4) If the manual header shows COMPLETE, run the normal read: code it against exp87a 0.959 with the UNPROVEN-ins flag, run the UP test with 'timeout 180 python tools/uptest.py save post_exp89t' only on 0.959, and push the user in MSK at once. This replaces the 19:47Z poll.log re-read. Log it in CONTEXT before 17:53Z with the corrected odds (~0.1-0.15%, private EV ~0).
realistic_gain: ~0.1-0.15% chance of a correct V_pub switch to exp89t that would otherwise code '?'. Expected private gain ~0 (DIS ~ 0). It is a correct procedure at the cost of 1 read-only call, not a score lever.
